# Steno Start Open Dictionary

> A 500-word beginner dictionary for the 22-key steno keyboard, published as Plover-style JSON under CC BY-SA 4.0 with per-entry provenance. Derived only from openly licensed sources.

## Canonical facts

- Name: Steno Start Open Dictionary
- Repository: https://github.com/thebillington/steno-start-open-dict
- Project site: https://stenostart.uk/dictionary/
- Format: JSON, flat `word -> stroke` map plus optional multi-stroke forms
- Words: 500 unique single-stroke signatures
- Structure: 99 brief entries and 401 rule-derived entries
- Multi-stroke forms: 8 optional expansions
- Licence: dictionary data and provenance CC BY-SA 4.0; generator and engine MIT
- Sources: CMUdict, Wikipedia Stenotype, Plover Wiki theory pages and the archived Art of Chording text
- Excluded: Plover `main.json`, GPL dictionaries, Typey Type, Lapwing, StenEd, Magnum and Phoenix dictionaries
- Provenance: one record per word in `provenance/entries.json`; source hashes in `data/manifest.json`
- Accuracy: 394/500 exact matches against the external Plover reference used for benchmarking; no claim of full Plover compatibility
- Affiliation: independent; not affiliated with Plover or Open Steno
- Support: https://github.com/sponsors/thebillington

## Files

- `data/dictionary.json` — flat word-to-stroke map.
- `data/multi_stroke.json` — optional multi-stroke expansions.
- `data/manifest.json` — counts, hashes and build command.
- `provenance/entries.json` — per-entry source and rule records.
- `validation/self_check.md` — parser, key-count, duplicate and coverage checks.
- `validation/report.md` — black-box comparison report.
- `CITATION.cff` — citation metadata.

## Attribution

Cite as "Steno Start Open Dictionary, Billy Rebecchi, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://github.com/thebillington/steno-start-open-dict". Share-alike applies to adapted dictionary data.
